mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_type AS docType, title, content_md AS contentMd, source_filename AS sourceFilename, status, published_at AS publishedAt, published_by AS publishedBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sys_legal_doc ORDER BY doc_type ASC

SELECT id, doc_type AS docType, title, content_md AS contentMd, source_filename AS sourceFilename, status, published_at AS publishedAt, published_by AS publishedBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sys_legal_doc WHERE doc_type = #{docType} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, doc_type AS docType, title, content_md AS contentMd, published_at AS publishedAt FROM sys_legal_doc WHERE doc_type = #{docType} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_legal_doc (doc_type, title, content_md, status, updated_by) VALUES (#{docType}, #{title}, #{contentMd}, #{status}, #{updatedBy})
